app: Local Image main (0.7.3 Linux preview interface)
capture: Actual application screenshots from the source build in a browser window; no mocked network responses, fabricated UI, or screenshot editing. No ComfyUI or model files were available, so no model output appears in these captures.

screenshots.caption: Quick Heal brush painted over the red mug in the Retouch workspace. The selection is the app's real brush input; the Heal button applies the CPU repair on its own layer.
The Layer menu with the same image open: new retouch layer, editable mask, rename, lock and move commands next to the Layers panel.
Two images open as tabs, with the filmstrip for a multi-image upload. Unsaved documents carry a dot on their tab.
The Cutout workspace after Layer → Add editable mask: Erase and Restore brush modes, Add background and Edge & shadow controls, and the mask as its own layer.
The Remove backgrounds dialog from the Cutout workspace: output background choice, removal model, per-image selection and previous batches.

The Generate panel in Create mode: model and precision pickers, prompt, linked width and height, transparent PNG option, sampling and image inputs. ComfyUI was not running when this was captured, so the model reads as unavailable.
Settings → Local AI → Model details…: download size, GPU memory recommendation, recommended steps, notes and licence for each supported model.
Settings → Local AI: ComfyUI backend, model folder, model download controls, FLUX AI Remove option and GPU memory.
The same workspace at Settings → Interface size → Large, with the Assets dock open.
